best.idea: Split A*x into eight-column tiles shared by lane pairs, then exchange partial sums. Each lane loads only eight x values, and the reduced results feed the existing two-row B pipeline.

attempts.idea: Assign two rows of each matrix to each lane. Alternate the two dot products to sustain one matrix load and one MAC every two cycles. Bank-color matrix entries by row, rotate shared-vector reads across lanes, and retain each lane’s two A*x values for local reuse in the second stage.
Move the second A*x publication into the second-stage writeback gap. Start the first B octet one cycle earlier, then use its trailing load slot to prefetch a coefficient for the second octet.
